queries.fullSourceStatement: DC_Main.RsQry = Conversions.ToString(Operators.ConcatenateObject(Operators.ConcatenateObject(Operators.ConcatenateObject((object)("INSERT INTO DM_DATA (CO_CODE,LC_CODE,CO_YEAR,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,MAIN_SRNO,SR_NO,ISR_NO,VCH_DATE,ENTRY_TYPE,BOOK_NAME,AC_CODE,IT_CODE,  DM_CODE,DM_ORIGIN,DM_REMARK,DM_SIZE,DM_COLOR,DM_LOT_NO,DM_PCS,DM_WT,DM_SIGN,DM_RATE,DM_AMT,EMP_CODE,TAG_NO,VCH_SRNO,MAIN_IT_CODE,INOUT_TYPE,TBL_CODE)  Select A.CO_CODE,A.LC_CODE,A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,2,A.SR_NO,A.ISR_NO,A.VCH_DATE,'S',B.BOOK_SNAME,A.AC_CODE,A.IT_CODE,  A.DM_CODE,A.DM_ORIGIN,A.DM_REMARK,A.DM_SIZE,A.DM_COLOR,'',A.IT_PCS,A.IT_GWT,'+',IT_RATE,IT_AMT,'',A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,D.IT_CODE,'I',D.TBL_CODE FROM ((BAR_DETL AS D INNER JOIN BAR_IDTL AS A ON D.CO_CODE = A.CO_CODE AND D.LC_CODE = A.LC_CODE AND D.CO_YEAR = A.CO_YEAR AND D.CO_BOOK = A.CO_BOOK AND D.VCH_NO = A.VCH_NO AND D.OLD_SRNO = A.SR_NO) LEFT JOIN BOOK_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_BOOK = B.CO_BOOK)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = C.IT_CODE  WHERE A.CO_CODE = '" + DC_Main.MCo_code + "' AND A.LC_CODE = '" + DC_Main.MLc_code + "' AND A.CO_YEAR = '" + DC_Main.MCo_year + "' AND B.MAIN_BOOK IN ('SALES RETURNE') "), Interaction.IIf(Operators.CompareString(StkBook, "", false) == 0, (object)"", (object)(" AND A.CO_BOOK ='" + StkBook + "'"))), Interaction.IIf(Operators.CompareString(StkVchNo, "", false) == 0, (object)"", (object)(" AND A.VCH_NO ='" + StkVchNo + "'"))), (object)" AND C.OTH_DETL_POSTING = 'Y' "));
